addressed_findings.issue: Initial new footnote fixture kept note reference and backreference within the same merged page, leaving cross-page footnote ownership unproven.
addressed_findings.resolution: Reference moved to first page; test explicitly verifies link to note on merged second page and backlink to first-page reference.

implementation_review.mutation_scope: 10 added lines after existing HAST partitioning and before part metadata derivation; only complete final nodes appended to predecessor; no canonical/source/download changes.
implementation_review.bounds: Tail must be strictly below existing 0.65*maxHtmlBytes target; complete merged serialized UTF8 nodes must be <=existing3*maxHtmlBytes ceiling. Existing default180000 unchanged. Finite while loop decreases group count each merge.
implementation_review.semantics: Predecessor context retained; ordered nodes appended intact; source ownership, anchors, ToC and links derived after packing. H1 remains unique and first-page owned. Atomic oversized units remain unmerged.
implementation_review.material_behavior_disclosed: Continuation URLs can disappear; anchors relocate to current owning pages; internal routing regenerated. Page-scoped search record counts/query granularity can change. No old-URL compatibility or same-wire guarantee claimed for new layout.
implementation_review.product_qualification: Actual final file count and bilingual search/static/browser/resource gates still required; 19777 projected files is not observed qualification.

independent_checks.method: Deterministic independent multilingual HAST/source/anchor fidelity exercise
assertions: Flattened HAST node content and order byte-identical to single-part render.
Complete source inventories and source node IDs identical and in preserved rendered order.
All local heading/H1/footnote destinations resolve through new owning parts.
Every rendered source block passes text/table/list/code fidelity checks.
